title: Expand ruff linter rules and tighten ignored rules
description:
We currently enable E, W, F, I, UP, B, SIM, RUF, and PLC0415. There are several useful rule categories we should add.

High priority (near-zero false positives):
- T10 (flake8-debugger): catch leftover pdb/breakpoint() calls
- ISC (flake8-implicit-str-concat): catch accidental 'foo' 'bar' concatenation bugs
- PIE (flake8-pie): unnecessary pass, dict/list comprehension improvements
- PERF (perflint): catch inefficient patterns like unnecessary list() wrapping
- RET (flake8-return): detect inconsistent return patterns (implicit None)

Medium priority:
- LOG (flake8-logging): enforce proper logging patterns
- TID (flake8-tidy-imports): catch unused noqa directives, import clarity
- BLE (flake8-blind-except): encourage catching specific exceptions (78 except blocks in codebase)
- ARG (flake8-unused-arguments): find unused function/test parameters

Also review the currently ignored rules (SIM102, SIM105, SIM115) to see if any can be un-ignored now.
